title: CombatGuard
description: CombatGuard is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds a configurable combat tag system to your server.
body:
CombatGuard is a lightweight Paper plugin that adds a configurable combat tag system to your server.

Players are tagged after PvP damage and can be prevented from using commands, teleporting or safely logging out while in combat. The tag duration, worlds, gamemodes, blocked commands, blocked teleport causes and logout punishment are fully configurable. The plugin is exploit-safe, performance-friendly and useful for PvP, survival, factions and SMP servers.

Commands:

/combatguard reloadconfig Reloads the config.yml without restarting the server.

/combatguard untag <player|all> Removes combat tags from one player or all players.

Permissions:

combatguard.bypass

Allows players to bypass all combat tag restrictions.

combatguard.reload

Allows reloading the config with /combatguard reloadconfig (default: OP).

combatguard.untag

Allows removing combat tags with /combatguard untag <player|all> (default: OP).
